description: This file contains configuration utilities for setting up camera sessions using AVFoundation. It defines error enums, and static functions to add camera input, photo output, and movie output to an AVCaptureSession, including handling for audio input and recording duration.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the given AVCaptureSession, throwing an error if it fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Adds a photo output to the session and configures photo quality; returns the output.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Adds a movie output to the session, optionally with audio input, and sets the maximum recording duration.
